description: This file contains unit tests for the QueueType class using Google Test framework, testing basic queue operations such as insert, post, remove, extract, and state control functions.

classes.name: QueueType<int>
classes.description: A template class representing a queue, used here specifically with int type for testing.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an item into the queue with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the queue.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts an item from the queue, with a timeout.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the queue.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue.
